description: This file defines a React functional component called EntityScaffold, which provides a generic scaffolding UI for displaying a list of entities and optionally creating new entities via a form. It incorporates UI components like Button, Card, Input, Select, TextArea, and DataTable from a themed component library. The component manages internal state for opening/closing the create form and handling form input values.

methods.name: EntityScaffold
methods.description: A React functional component providing a generic scaffold for entity list display and creation form.
